description: This PHP script is designed for sending emails using the PHPMailer library. It includes a function 'sendmail' that configures and sends an email via SMTP, with parameters for recipient, sender, subject, content, SMTP server details, and optional filename attachments. The script also requires external dependencies for SMTP and PHPMailer classes, as well as a utility file.

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: A class for constructing and sending emails via SMTP or other methods, from the included library.

methods.name: sendmail
methods.description: Function to send an email with specified parameters, using PHPMailer configured for SMTP.
